tools.name: get_similar_tracks
tools.description: find tracks that sound similar to a given track. similarity is computed from the audio itself, not tags, genres or listening history, so matches cross genre lines. returns the source track plus ranked matches, each scored 0 to 1 by cosine similarity where 1 is most alike.

track.description: the track to match against. accepts a cosine.club /track/ url, a numeric track id, or free text like "moodymann - jan" which is resolved by searching first. omit on a track page to use the track being viewed.

limit.description: how many similar tracks to return, 1 to 10.

tools.name: search_tracks
tools.description: search the cosine.club catalog by artist name or track title. over two million tracks, mostly electronic and underground music: house, techno, uk garage, jungle, breakbeat, electro, ambient, dub, disco and more. returns matching tracks with their cosine.club urls.

query.description: an artist name, a track title, or both together like "moodymann - jan". only artist and track text is indexed, so searching a label or release name matches those words in artist and track names instead.

limit.description: how many tracks to return, 1 to 10.
